grammar.title: Types of Films — Vocabulary
grammar.rule:
📘 **Жанры фильмов на английском**:

🎬 **action film** — боевик
😂 **comedy** — комедия
❤️ **romance** — романтический фильм
😱 **horror film** — фильм ужасов
🤯 **thriller** — триллер

🧙 **fantasy** — фэнтези
🪐 **science fiction (sci-fi)** — научная фантастика

📌 **Пример**:
I love action films. They are exciting!
I don't like horror films. They are too scary.

📌 **Пример**:

'I love Harry Potter! It's fantasy!' 🧙

days.title: Day 2: Describing a Film
days.description: Учимся описывать фильмы и свои впечатления

grammar.title: Describing a Film — Vocabulary
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как описывать фильм**:

📌 **Сюжет (plot)**:
✅ The film is about... — Фильм о...
✅ The main character is... — Главный герой — это...

📌 **Впечатления**:
✅ The film is exciting. — Фильм захватывающий.
✅ It's a must-see! — Это обязательно к просмотру!
✅ It's well worth seeing. — Это стоит посмотреть.
✅ The acting is wonderful. — Игра актёров великолепна.

📌 **Пример**:
Harry Potter is about a young wizard. The acting is wonderful. It's a must-see!

vocabulary.example: The plot of the film is interesting.

My favourite scene is at the end.

days.title: Day 3: Grammar — Past Simple (irregular verbs)
days.description: Учим неправильные глаголы в прошедшем времени

grammar.title: Past Simple — Irregular Verbs
grammar.rule:
📘 **Неправильные глаголы в Past Simple**:

Неправильные глаголы не образуют Past Simple по правилу (+ed). Их нужно запомнить!

📌 **Группа 1 (меняют гласную)**:
✅ begin → **began** (начал)
✅ drink → **drank** (пил)
✅ sing → **sang** (пел)
✅ swim → **swam** (плавал)

📌 **Группа 2 (меняют всё слово)**:
✅ go → **went** (пошёл)
✅ see → **saw** (увидел)
✅ take → **took** (взял)
✅ eat → **ate** (съел)
✅ have → **had** (имел)
✅ make → **made** (сделал)

📌 **Группа 3 (совсем другие)**:
✅ buy → **bought** (купил)
✅ think → **thought** (думал)
✅ find → **found** (нашёл)
✅ write → **wrote** (написал)
✅ read → **read** (читал — произносится /red/)

📌 **Пример**:
I **saw** a film yesterday.
She **went** to the cinema.
We **ate** popcorn.

exercises.question: What is the past form of 'go'? 🚶
What is the past form of 'see'? 👀
I ___ (eat) popcorn at the cinema. 🍿
She ___ (buy) a ticket for the film. 🎫
I goed to the cinema yesterday.
exercises.correct: I went to the cinema yesterday.
accept: I went to the cinema yesterday
I went to the cinema yesterday.

exercises.question: What film did Samantha watch? 🎬
exercises.explanation: Samantha watched Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince! 🧙
exercises.readingText:
🌟 FILM REVIEW EMAIL 🌟

From: Samantha
To: Julia
Subject: I saw a great film!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Hi Julia,

How are you? I had a great weekend. I went to the cinema on Saturday night with my friends. We saw Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince. It's a fantasy film starring Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint and Emma Watson.

The film is about Harry Potter getting ready to face Voldemort. The acting was wonderful. I found the film exciting. It's a must-see for everyone!

How about you? Did you go to the seaside last weekend?

Love,
Samantha

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

days.title: Day 5: Past Simple Practice — Irregular Verbs
days.description: Тренируем неправильные глаголы в прошедшем времени

grammar.title: Past Simple — Irregular Verbs Practice
grammar.rule:
📘 **Вспоминаем неправильные глаголы**:

📌 **Повторение**:
✅ go → went
✅ see → saw
✅ eat → ate
✅ buy → bought
✅ write → wrote
✅ read → read (произносится /red/)
✅ take → took
✅ make → made
✅ have → had
✅ find → found

📌 **Пример**:
I **saw** a film yesterday.
She **bought** popcorn.
We **had** a great time.

exercises.question: I ___ a great film last night. 🎬
She ___ (buy) a new dress yesterday. 🛍️
The past form of 'read' is pronounced like 'reed'.
exercises.explanation: The past form of 'read' is pronounced /red/, not /riːd/! 📖

exercises.question: We ___ (go) to the cinema on Saturday. 🎬
She haved a great time at the cinema.
exercises.correct: She had a great time at the cinema.
accept: She had a great time at the cinema
She had a great time at the cinema.

days.title: Day 6: Writing — Film Review Email
days.description: Пишем письмо с отзывом о фильме

grammar.title: Повторение: Past Simple (irregular verbs)
grammar.rule:
📚 **План для письма**:

1️⃣ What film did you see? (Какой фильм ты посмотрел?)
2️⃣ What is the film about? (О чём фильм?)
3️⃣ Who stars in it? (Кто снимается?)
4️⃣ What did you think? (Что ты думаешь?)
5️⃣ Would you recommend it? (Ты бы порекомендовал?)

📌 **Пример**:
Hi Julia,

I saw Harry Potter last weekend. It's a fantasy film about a young wizard. Daniel Radcliffe stars in it. I found the film exciting. The acting was great. It's a must-see for everyone!

Write back soon!

Sam
